sources.snippet: Abstract KV caching is a ubiquitous optimization in autoregressive transformer inference, long presumed to be numerically equivalent to cache-free computation. This assumption fails under standard FP16 precision: cache-ON and cache-OFF execution paths employ different floating-point accumulation orderings which, due to FP16 non-associativity, produce a deterministic divergence in decoded token ...
